description: Probe of D-error-budget source #2 (Term 2+3 inclusion). Computes B_Term23(D) = Term23(p) + Term23(n) − Term23(D atom) from entanglement-orders.witness.json and tests whether adding it to existing Term 1+4 closes the +2.10% residual.
caveats: The entanglement-orders calibration fits proton mass exactly but undershoots neutron mass by 56%. The neutron undershoot propagates into atom-level Term 2+3, biasing B_Term23 toward wrong sign for D.
Term 1 (descended Markov trace) already encodes the relevant internal-tower content for binding via free-vs-atom subtraction. Adding Term 2+3 separately double-counts.
